notes.note_text: False. Japan hasn't banned Israeli tourists. This claim misrepresents isolated incidents where private hotels refused Israeli guests. Japanese officials warned one hotel this could be discrimination. No government ban exists. https://www.israelhayom.com/2025/12/22/japan-ban-israelis-false-claims-social-media/

North Korea has not shot down two American fighter jets. The only recorded incident was the shooting down of one unarmed U.S. Navy EC-121M reconnaissance plane in 1969. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1969_EC-121_shootdown_incident

This claim is false. It originated from a parody account (Hoops Crave) after Kai Cenat's breakup. Alayah denied it on Instagram, stating she has no connection to NBA YoungBoy and never cheated. https://tribune.com.pk/story/2586704/rumours-linking-gigi-alayah-to-nba-youngboy-pregnancy-debunked-after-parody-post-goes-viral

**False claims.** Rebecca is identified as Renee Good's wife in multiple reports. A fact-check found no evidence Renee had criminal charges or lost custody. Her older kids live with their father; her 6-year-old was with her until her death. https://www.limitless-news.com/local/renee-good-false-information

The post implies Nicole Good had a criminal record. The viral "rap sheet" belongs to a different person—Nicole Renee Good, born 1980, age 44. Renee Nicole Good was 37, born 1988, and had no criminal record beyond a parking ticket. https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/did-renee-nicole-good-have-criminal-past-truth-behind-viral-claim-in-minneapolis-ice-shooting-101768097422277.html

Walz explicitly refused to resign on Jan 6, 2026, stating "Over my dead body will that happen." He dropped his re-election bid but committed to serving his term. No evidence supports claims of a criminal indictment referral against Walz. https://www.foxnews.com/politics/walz-refuses-quit-after-dropping-re-election-bid-amid-minnesota-fraud-firestorm-over-my-dead-body

**Wrong record.** The rap sheet shown is for "Nicole Renee Good" (DOB 1980), not Renée Nicole Macklin Good, the 37-year-old from Colorado in the Minneapolis incident. Fact-checkers confirm the actual Renée Good had no felony history—only a 2012 traffic ticket. https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/did-renee-nicole-good-have-criminal-past-truth-behind-viral-claim-in-minneapolis-ice-shooting-101768097422277.html

The attached CNN image is fabricated. Denmark has not withdrawn recognition of Kosovo. As of April 2025, Denmark reaffirmed its support for Kosovo at the UN Security Council. https://dkonunsc.dk/statements/08-04-2025-statement-by-denmark-at-the-unsc-briefing-on-kosovo-unmik-

The viral screenshot of "leaked texts" between Carson Beck and Hanna Cavinder is fake. Total Pro Sports debunked this fabricated image that fooled many fans. No credible evidence exists that Beck leaked genuine messages from Cavinder. https://www.totalprosports.com/ncaa/viral-carson-beck-hanna-cavinder-leaked-dms-internet-reacts/

No verifiable record exists of Baba Vanga predicting an alien spaceship entering Earth's atmosphere or WWIII for 2026. These claims originate from tabloids, not verified sources. https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/9-11-princess-diana-baba-vangas-alleged-2026-alien-world-war-iii-predictions-go-viral-1769563

The USPS letter is a standard "essential services" letter, reminding employees and contractors that they are classified as essential workers and may need to travel during emergencies; it does not announce or predict a new, specific crisis. https://news.usps.com/2020/12/10/essential-service/
Brett Favre denies giving up hope in his battle with Parkinson's disease. https://www.tmz.com/2026/01/07/brett-favre-denies-health-report-parkinsons-battle/

The claim that Putin warned the US about WWIII over the seized tanker is false. Russia's Foreign Ministry protested diplomatically. No WWIII threat was made. https://www.rferl.org/a/us-forces-russian-tanker-marinera-atlantic-ocean-oil/33642224.html

The claim that Vikings were on Greenland before the Inuit arrived is incorrect. The Dorset people, a pre-Inuit culture, arrived in Greenland around 700 AD, predating the Viking arrival in 982 AD. https://www.quarkexpeditions.com/blog/greenlands-thule-and-vikings-more-than-ancient-history
LeBron James is not currently 41 years old. As of today, he is 39 years old; he will turn 40 on December 30, 2024. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LeBron_James

Images show 1990s Battle of Mogadishu in Somalia, not Venezuela. Soldiers wear desert camouflage from 1993 operations against Somali militia, documented in historical records of that conflict. https://www.armytimes.com/news/your-army/2023/11/06/forgotten-bastards-battle-of-mogadishus-unsung-heroes-await-honors/

This claim is false - Frank Grillo has not passed away. Multiple credible sources confirm he is alive, including his Wikipedia page which lists recent 2024 film credits, and news reports from July 2025 about him surviving a Delta flight emergency landing. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Grillo

Microsoft renamed the "Microsoft 365 app" (a productivity hub) to "Microsoft 365 Copilot App" - not Microsoft Office itself. The core Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) keeps the Microsoft Office name. https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/the-microsoft-365-app-transition-to-the-microsoft-365-copilot-app-22eac811-08d6-4df3-92dd-77f193e354a5

False. No credible sources confirm Smith entered the transfer portal. Reports describe this as hypothetical only, with "no indication Smith is even considering entering the portal." https://www.si.com/fannation/college/cfb-hq/nil/4-million-price-tag-projected-if-college-football-wr-jeremiah-smith-makes-transfer-portal-decision

The rock shown is a dropstone - a boulder dropped from icebergs/ice into calm sediments, creating the vertical deformation pattern. Dropstones form from glacial processes over long periods, not flood events. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dropstone

No credible sources support Jennifer King as expected Raiders head coach. She currently coaches at North Carolina Central University after her Bears tenure ended. https://andscape.com/features/jennifer-king-first-made-history-in-the-nfl-then-made-more-at-north-carolina-central/

Post falsely claims Joshua was "crying his eyes out" when receiving bodies. Sources report he viewed them "calmly for about 10 minutes" and was "composed, not emotional in the claimed manner." https://guardian.ng/news/the-last-minutes-anthony-joshua-visits-funeral-home-pays-final-respects-to-sina-latif/

Post falsely claims missiles landed in Russia's EEZ with "irregular trajectories." Japan's Defense Ministry confirmed missiles fell in Sea of Japan outside Japan's EEZ, no mention of Russia's EEZ or irregular paths. https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3338644/north-korean-missile-falls-near-japan-takaichi-orders-safety-checks

Panthers haven't been eliminated from playoffs. NFL.com confirms they can still clinch if Falcons lose Sunday, creating 3-way tie despite losing control of their destiny after TB loss. https://www.nfl.com/news/panthers-buccaneers-saturday-week-18-what-we-learned-tampa-bay-win

E-6B aircraft operate at high altitudes (20,000+ ft) in offshore circles for VLF missions, not low loops over land. Emergency Action Messages are encrypted military communications not receivable by civilian radio equipment. https://www.twz.com/31477/heres-why-an-e-6b-doomsday-plane-was-flying-tight-circles-off-the-jersey-shore-today

Post incorrectly claims Avdol has white/yellow skin in original manga. Avdol was born in Cairo, Egypt and depicted with darker brown skin tones consistent with his Egyptian heritage in Araki's original artwork. https://jojowiki.com/Muhammad_Avdol

This claim is debunked. The allegation comes from a Turkish newspaper with no evidence (no bank statements/documents). Fact-checkers found no credible evidence supporting the $50M transfer claim. https://truthmeter.mk/there-is-no-evidence-that-zelensky-transfers-50-million-monthly-to-his-account-in-the-uae/

The post falsely claims an Alabama player proposed to his sister after the 2017 National Championship. In reality, Alabama offensive lineman Bradley Bozeman proposed to his girlfriend (not his sister) after winning the championship following the 2017 season. https://6abc.com/amp/post/alabama-player-proposes-after-winning-national-championship/2916901/

The post falsely claims that 5 submarine telecommunication cables were destroyed. According to multiple news reports, only 1 cable between Finland and Estonia was damaged, not 5. Additionally, Finnish Border Guard and police (not military "forces") conducted the seizure. https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/01/01/finland-seizes-cargo-ship-suspected-of-damaging-undersea-cable-a91598

Multiple sources contradict this claim. Wikipedia lists Tom Holland as expected to reprise Spider-Man, and ScreenRant reports expectations of his involvement. No official Marvel confirmation supports his exclusion. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avengers:_Doomsday

Swiss authorities explicitly ruled out terrorism. Valais police, security chief Stephane Ganzer, and Attorney General Beatrice Pilloud state no suspects, no arrests, no deliberate attack indication. Cause appears accidental. https://news.sky.com/story/switzerland-latest-several-killed-after-explosion-at-swiss-ski-resort-bar-reports-13489063

False. Upchurch never said Michelle Obama is a man. He consistently described her as female in interviews, calling her a "wonderful person" and praising her ambitions from their high school relationship. https://fullfact.org/online/michelle-obama-man-claim-ex-boyfriend-false/

London officials denied deliberate removal. Technical issues affected multiple blue/white flags (Guatemala, Argentina, Honduras) identically during the animated display. https://www.standard.co.uk/news/london/london-nye-fireworks-israeli-flag-star-of-david-outrage-b1264601.html

The Star of David wasn't "removed" but affected by a technical glitch that also impacted Guatemala, Argentina & Honduras flags. The Star became faintly visible at sequence end. City Hall denied intentional censorship. https://www.gbnews.com/news/sadiq-khan-new-year-london-fireworks-israel

These images show the 1893 World's Fair's temporary "White City" fairgrounds, not everyday Chicago. The neoclassical buildings were built specifically for the 6-month exposition and demolished by 1894, not representative of how Chicago actually looked. https://www.architecture.org/online-resources/architecture-encyclopedia/worlds-columbian-exposition-of-1893

Incorrect. Kai Cenat & Gabrielle Alayah broke up in Dec 2025, not reconciled. Cenat announced he's "single" on Dec 27. Alayah denied cheating allegations: "I've never cheated on you, and YOU know that." https://www.indy100.com/viral/kai-cenat-gabrielle-alayah-breakup

The post incorrectly claims a bomb exploded at the hospital. Kebbi State officials and police have confirmed the explosion was caused by overheated gas cylinders from air conditioning and refrigeration units in the hospital staff quarters, not a bomb. https://www.nigeriainfo.fm/lagos/news/homepagelagos/bagudo-hospital-blast-linked-to-gas-cylinder-fire-not-bomb/

The image shared in this post shows a dead falcon, not a bald eagle, and was taken in Israel in 2017. The bird species was misidentified in the post. https://www.the-independent.com/news/world/americas/us-politics/newsom-trolls-trump-windmills-bald-eagles-falcon-b2892507.html

This post falsely claims Bowen Yang is dead. Yang is alive and recently announced his SNL departure after 7 seasons, with his final episode airing Dec 20, 2025. No credible sources report his death. https://cbsaustin.com/news/entertainment/bowen-yang-bids-emotional-farewell-to-snl-after-7-seasons-teases-dreamiest-send-off

The linked image falsely claims Jill Biden was Joe's teenage babysitter. She was 23 when they met in 1975, not 15. They married in 1977 when she was 25. No credible evidence supports babysitting claims. https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2021/feb/22/viral-image/no-jill-biden-wasnt-teenage-babysitter-joe-bidens-/

Harvard didn't "just release" these courses. They're part of an ongoing catalog of 100+ free courses available continuously through Harvard's platform, not a recent 2025 release. https://pll.harvard.edu/catalog/free

Post claims "no one is saying anything about the two [deceased victims]" but major outlets prominently reported both deaths alongside Joshua's injuries, directly contradicting this assertion. https://news.sky.com/story/anthony-joshua-injured-in-car-crash-in-nigeria-police-say-13488263
False. Højlund scored 10 league goals for Man United, not 4 as claimed. He has scored 4-6 for Napoli, which is less than his United total. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rasmus_H%C3%B8jlund

The post falsely claims this shows "SpaceX failing." The image shows wreckage from a highway accident on I-95 near Kennedy Space Center, not any SpaceX failure. This was either a 2018 family traffic crash or 2025 police pursuit - both unrelated to SpaceX. https://www.clickorlando.com/news/2018/04/03/family-killed-in-violent-crash-after-watching-spacex-launch-idd/

Modern dimes (1965+) contain zero silver - they're copper-nickel alloy. Only 1946-1964 dimes contain 90% silver. The "infinite money glitch" fails because current dimes lack silver content needed for the scheme. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roosevelt_dime

The image shows outdated assist numbers. Current data shows Messi has 407 career assists compared to Ronaldo's 260 assists, not the higher numbers displayed in the image. https://www.messivsronaldo.app/detailed-stats/opta-assists/

The Lana Del Rey comment screenshot is fake. The "this twink can't act for shit" comment was AI-generated or edited, not a real statement from the singer. https://thetab.com/2025/12/01/this-twink-cant-act-for-sht-explaining-lana-del-rey-dragging-noah-schnapp-in-stranger-things

GitHub wasn't created by Linus Torvalds - it was founded in 2008 by Tom Preston-Werner, Chris Wanstrath, PJ Hyett & Scott Chacon. Linus created Git (2005), not GitHub or Arch Linux (created by Judd Vinet in 2002). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GitHub

The post reacts to incorrect information showing Jordan Love as older than he actually is. Jordan Love is 27 years old (born November 2, 1998), not 33 as apparently shown in the linked image. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jordan_Love

This claim is false. Steph Curry and Ayesha Curry are not getting divorced. The divorce rumors were based on misinterpreted comments from Ayesha's podcast appearance, and both have publicly dismissed these rumors through social media posts celebrating their 14-year marriage. https://www.hindustantimes.com/infotainment/fact-check-is-steph-curry-getting-divorced-wife-ayeshas-call-her-daddy-appearance-sparks-rumor-101760806509577.html

The "Letter of Pilate to Tiberius" cited for Jesus's appearance is not authentic. Scholars reject this document, which first appeared in the 15th century—1,400+ years after Jesus. No reliable contemporary descriptions of Jesus exist. https://www.roger-pearse.com/weblog/2012/05/11/the-letter-of-pilate-to-tiberius/

Post claims strategy "always" solves Wordle by turn 4. Research by Prof. Smyth (University College Dublin) found even optimal 3-word strategies only achieve 97% success rate, not 100%. Some puzzles remain unsolvable, contradicting "always." https://www.sfi.ie/research-news/news/wordle-data-analytics/

The post falsely claims Texas is the "FIRST STATE" to stop lab-grown food products. Texas actually became the **seventh state** to ban lab-grown meat, joining Nebraska, Indiana, Mississippi, Florida, Alabama, and Montana that had already enacted similar bans. https://www.qualityassurancemag.com/news/texas-becomes-seventh-state-to-ban-lab-grown-meat/

The post claims Owens "took down all her recent videos" herself, but YouTube removed specific videos and suspended her account in September 2024 due to policy violations, not voluntary removal by Owens. https://www.algemeiner.com/2024/09/10/youtube-suspends-candace-owens-demonetizes-her-account-hate-speech-kanye-west-interview/

Misleading: FBI isn't being "FULLY SHUT DOWN." Patel announced FBI headquarters is relocating from J. Edgar Hoover Building to Ronald Reagan Building a few blocks away in Downtown D.C. The FBI continues operating—only changing locations. https://wtop.com/dc/2025/12/j-edgar-hoover-building-to-close-for-good-as-fbi-relocates-its-hq-patel-says/

Soviet leaders contradicted this claim. Stalin told Roosevelt/Churchill at Tehran Conference 1943: "Without Lend-Lease, we would have lost the war." Khrushchev said Western trucks/equipment prevented "colossal losses" in 1944-45 offensives. https://www.nationalww2museum.org/war/articles/lend-lease-eastern-front

The post incorrectly characterizes these as "Christmas bonuses." The $240 million in bonuses began being distributed in June 2025 following the $1.7 billion sale of Fibrebond to Eaton, not as Christmas bonuses in December. https://cbs12.com/news/nation-world/graham-walker-fibrebond-eaton-boss-gifts-workers-240-million-in-bonuses-after-17-billion-sale-of-family-company-cincinnati-manufacturing-blue-collar-workhorse-society-business-owners-shifts-stock-ownership-campus-non-negotiable-requirement-retirement

Banks was exposed for crypto manipulation, not viewbotting. Leaked messages show he orchestrated a pump-and-dump scheme with MLG token, causing $150M losses when it crashed 93%. No evidence supports $20M viewbotting claims. https://crypto.news/faze-crypto-drama-deepens-as-leaked-chats-expose-backdoor-dealings/

Fact-checkers found this viral photo misleading. Snopes investigated and determined it doesn't reliably show these three Home Alone stars meeting in LA as claimed. https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/home-alone-reunion-photos/

Nvidia didn't acquire Groq. Per Groq's official statement, they entered a non-exclusive licensing agreement with personnel transfers. Groq continues operating independently under new leadership, not as Nvidia subsidiary. https://groq.com/newsroom/groq-and-nvidia-enter-non-exclusive-inference-technology-licensing-agreement-to-accelerate-ai-inference-at-global-scale

Xbox hasn't officially confirmed GTA 6's file size as 676.7 GB. This claim stems from unverified screenshots circulating on social media, not official Xbox/Microsoft announcements or verified Xbox Store listings. https://icon-era.com/threads/xbox-confirms-gta-6s-wild-file-size-nearly-700-gb.19087/

Post falsely claims Judge Ali "is still a foreign citizen." Ali is a confirmed U.S. District Judge nominated by Biden and confirmed by Senate - requiring U.S. citizenship. Though born in Canada, he officially serves as federal judge. https://www.fjc.gov/history/judges/ali-amir-hatem-mahdy

This appears to be a cryptocurrency scam. Security researchers warn that fake ChainOpera airdrop campaigns impersonate the legitimate project to steal funds when users provide wallet information. https://www.pcrisk.com/removal-guides/34008-chainopera-ai-coai-airdrop-scam

Misleading. Marge died only in a non-canon future fantasy storyline. Producer Matt Selman confirmed "The Simpsons doesn't have canon" and "Marge will probably never be dead ever again." https://www.tvinsider.com/1199790/the-simpsons-marge-death-reports-matt-selman-reaction/

The post appears to be sharing/endorsing a debunked claim about Andrew Tate betting $10 million on himself to lose and profiting $88 million. This claim has been thoroughly debunked with no credible evidence supporting any such betting scheme. https://www.primetimer.com/features/did-andrew-tate-bet-on-himself-to-lose-viral-88-million-profit-claim-debunked

Flight logs show Trump flew on Epstein's jet 7 times between 1993-1997, not "at least 8 times between 1993-1996." The timeframe extends to 1997 and the count is 7, not 8+. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Relationship_between_Donald_Trump_and_Jeffrey_Epstein

The post falsely claims "Human DNA components" were found in a meteorite. No DNA was detected - only simple organic compounds like amino acids that are commonly found in meteorites, not actual DNA molecules. https://scienceandculture.com/2025/11/a-fake-headline-and-a-real-one-about-dna/

This quote is fabricated. No "WHO Eugenics Council" exists. WHO has no records of Kissinger making this statement. Kissinger's office called it "complete fabrication." Multiple fact-checkers confirmed it's false. https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2019/jun/25/facebook-posts/henry-kissinger-never-said-once-herd-accepts-manda/

DOJ accidentally included a long-debunked fake video that's circulated online for years, then removed it after realizing the error. Not a "shocking" new release - this animated clip was posted on YouTube ~5 years ago. https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/doj-posts-fake-epstein-death-video-deletes-it-after-backslash-heres-the-real-story-behind-the-12-second-clip-101766452883964.html

Wintrich wasn't arrested "for merely saying 'it's ok to be white'" but for an altercation when an audience member took his speech papers at UConn in Nov 2017. Charges against him were dropped; the woman was charged instead. https://www.insidehighered.com/news/2017/11/29/talk-uconn-draws-protests-and-speaker-arrested

The post contains two significant factual errors: Joshua's purse was approximately $92-93 million (not $91 million), and more importantly, he is taking home approximately $74 million after taxes, not the $48 million claimed in the post. https://punchng.com/taxman-to-take-66m-from-joshuas-jake-paul-payday-report/

Post incorrectly states Cosmic Vine dates to "3 billion years after the Big Bang" - it actually dates to ~2 billion years after. At redshift z=3.44, "JWST saw these galaxies as they were when the Universe was around 2 billion years old." https://www.advancedsciencenews.com/cosmic-vine-discovered-by-the-james-webb-space-telescope/

False. SNL isn't featuring Candace Owens on Jan 10. Original post was from satirical account @DropPopNet. SNL doesn't air Jan 10 - resumes Jan 17 with Finn Wolfhard hosting, A$AP Rocky as musical guest. https://poprant.indiatimes.com/trending/will-snl-feature-candace-owens-as-a-host-alongside-musical-guest-nicki-minaj-heres-the-truth-behind-viral-claim-677703.html

These claims about Erika Kirk having affairs, divorce proceedings, and pregnancy are unsubstantiated rumors. No credible sources support these allegations, which have been documented as fictional stories circulating online. https://www.snopes.com/collections/erika-kirk-rumors/

This post falsely claims Obama will be indicted in January on federal charges. No such indictment exists. The viral arrest content is AI-generated fabrication, not real legal proceedings. https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-posts-ai-generated-video-showing-obama-getting-arrested-ymca

False. Pfizer has developed treatments/vaccines that prevented, treated & helped eliminate diseases including antibiotics (doxycycline), antifungals (fluconazole), & COVID-19 vaccine across 175 years. https://verafiles.org/articles/fact-check-claim-that-pfizer-hasnt-cured-any-disease-not-true

False. No credible sources confirm Breakker beat Punk for the title on pre-taped Raw. ESPN's recap and WWE's official Dec 15 Raw page show CM Punk retained the World Heavyweight Championship with no title change documented. https://www.espn.com/wwe/story/_/id/47255550/wwe-raw-recap-does-bron-breakker-really-want-old-cm-punk

The claim that Indie Game Awards disqualified Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is false. According to Game Informer, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 actually won Game of the Year at the Indie Game Awards, directly contradicting the disqualification claim made in this post. https://gameinformer.com/round-up/2025/12/19/clair-obscur-expedition-33-wins-another-game-of-the-year-at-the-indie-game

This post falsely attributes a quote to Taylor Swift. No evidence shows Swift said she'd "lose her career in US, but continue to criticise Israel's war crimes." The controversy involves fan audio mentioning "Israel" in her documentary, not Swift making statements. https://tribune.com.pk/story/2582095/taylor-swift-faces-backlash-after-israel-reference-in-the-end-of-an-era-documentary

Post falsely claims Nick Reiner "didn't have organic schizophrenia" and was "too old for that diagnosis." TMZ reports Reiner was actually diagnosed with schizophrenia and under psychiatric care before the incident. Later-onset schizophrenia occurs. https://www.tmz.com/2025/12/19/nick-reiner-diagnosed-with-schizophrenia/

False. Japan has not officially banned Israeli tourists. Only isolated private hotels/lodges refused bookings, not government policy. No official announcement from Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs exists. https://www.ynetnews.com/travel/article/b18wyx2gze

The post claims Muslims make up 24% of UK prison population, but official data shows Muslims comprise approximately 15-18% of prisoners, not 24%. While overrepresented vs general population, the 24% figure is incorrect. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom_prison_population

Post falsely claims newly released documents show Jackson flew on Epstein's jet. Released files only contain photos of Jackson with Epstein, not flight logs proving Jackson was a passenger on the "Lolita Express." https://foxbaltimore.com/news/nation-world/which-public-figures-are-in-epstein-files-bill-clinton-diana-ross-michael-jackson-mick-jagger-kevin-spacey-chris-tucker-phil-collins-minnie-driver-wiesel-names-images-documents

The post claims Trump's name appears "dozens of times" in Epstein flight logs, but according to DOJ documents and major news reporting, Trump's name appears approximately 7-8 times in the released flight logs from the 1990s, not dozens of times. https://abcnews.go.com/US/times-trumps-appeared-epstein-files-doj-released/story?id=123848078

The post claims the study found people who eat high-fat cheese "had lower rates of diabetes," but the Swedish study published in Neurology focused specifically on dementia outcomes and did not report findings about diabetes rates among high-fat cheese eaters. https://www.lunduniversity.lu.se/article/full-fat-cheese-linked-lower-risk-dementia

The post falsely claims 3I/ATLAS shows "new strange behavior" and suggests a close Earth pass. NASA reports 3I/ATLAS exhibits "extraordinarily normal" cometary behavior and passes ~170 million miles from Earth, not a close flyby. https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/comets/3i-atlas/

The post incorrectly identifies this as a "Finalissima 2016 result." This was actually the 2017 FIFA Confederations Cup semi-final between Portugal and Chile, played on June 28, 2017, where Chile won 3-0 on penalties after a 0-0 draw. https://www.espn.com/soccer/match/_/gameId/485908/chile-portugal

The photo shows Jeffrey Epstein with former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak, not Benjamin Netanyahu. These are two different people who have been misidentified in this post. https://www.trtworld.com/article/16616743

Wrestling outlets report the Monroe-Hail finish was botched but found no credible source confirming WWE fined Monroe 2 weeks salary or officially blamed her for the incident. https://www.si.com/fannation/wrestling/wwe/update-on-blake-monroe-accidentally-losing-the-wwe-nxt-women-north-american-title

The claim that Minnesota's website "changed" Omar's birth year is false. Minnesota's official database shows 1982 as correct and notes 1981 was "incorrectly reported in other sources." Multiple authoritative sources confirm 1982. https://www.lrl.mn.gov/legdb/fulldetail?id=15470

Post omits key update: While a federal judge blocked Texas's maps, the U.S. Supreme Court has since stayed that order, allowing Texas to use the 2025 maps during appeals. The block is not currently in effect. https://www.texastribune.org/2025/12/04/texas-redistricting-map-us-supreme-court-2026-midterms/

This post makes a false claim that Dan Marino is "reportedly considering coming out of retirement." No credible sports outlets have reported this story, and Marino currently serves only as a Special Advisor in the Dolphins' front office, not as an active player. https://www.miamidolphins.com/team/front-office-roster/dan-marino

Post falsely claims suspect has been "identified." RI Attorney General warned against social media doxxing and stated if investigators had a suspect's name, they would officially announce it. No law enforcement has identified him as suspect. https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/mustapha-kharbouch-brown-university-rhode-island-ag-respond-as-student-is-doxed-over-shooting-101765936032948.html

The linked image falsely claims the U.S. is 3rd in global murder rate and would rank 189th if certain cities were excluded. PolitiFact found the U.S. isn't 3rd globally, and those cities account for only 9% of U.S. homicides—removing them barely affects the rate. https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2018/mar/28/viral-image/united-states-third-murders-outlier-cities/
